# QCT Commerce

> QCT Commerce builds websites, e-commerce systems, search visibility and AI-supported digital sales infrastructure for businesses in Türkiye and Azerbaijan.

Verified contact: info@qctcommerce.com · WhatsApp: +90 545 678 26 55.

## Canonical language structure
- Turkish: https://qctcommerce.com/
- English: https://qctcommerce.com/en/
- Azerbaijani: https://qctcommerce.com/az/

TR, EN and AZ core commercial pages are reciprocal hreflang clusters. Azerbaijani is a full local-language site.

## Audiences
All three locales cover manufacturers, exporters, distributors/B2B and e-commerce brands.

## Knowledge base
TR, EN and AZ each publish 13 matched guide topics: marketplace economics, ikas pricing, Google visibility, ChatGPT/AI visibility, website pricing, ikas vs Shopify, mobile conversion, Shopify setup, e-commerce mistakes, marketplace-to-owned-store migration, SEO/GEO/AEO/AIO, AI product descriptions and WhatsApp sales automation.
Turkish: https://qctcommerce.com/blog/
English: https://qctcommerce.com/en/blog/
Azerbaijani: https://qctcommerce.com/az/bloq/

## Programmatic SEO
Turkish market/location hubs: https://qctcommerce.com/lokasyon/
English market/location hubs: https://qctcommerce.com/en/location/
Both generate 19 parent market/location pages. Selected international markets generate 3 service-intent children (web design, e-commerce, SEO/GEO), producing 12 service pages per TR/EN locale.

The Azerbaijani locale intentionally does not duplicate the same Azerbaijan intent under /az/azerbaycan/. https://qctcommerce.com/az/ and its local service pages are the canonical Azerbaijan-market targets, preventing keyword cannibalization.

## Search and AI discovery
Pages use self-canonical URLs, reciprocal hreflang where translations exist, XML sitemap discovery, structured data and internal links. Core service pages use Service schema, blog articles use Article schema, and work examples use CreativeWork schema.

Sitemap: https://qctcommerce.com/sitemap-index.xml
Robots: https://qctcommerce.com/robots.txt

## Legal
Privacy, KVKK information, terms and cookie information are available in TR, EN and AZ. The AZ KVKK page is an informational translation/summary of the applicable Turkish notice; Turkish law and the Turkish notice govern formal interpretation.

QCT Commerce is part of the wider QCT ecosystem. QCT Studio is a separate sister brand.
